description: This file defines a custom exception class 'ValidationException' used for validation error handling in the OrangeHRM system. It extends PHP's built-in InvalidArgumentException and includes additional properties to store validation input and rules.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: A specialized exception class for handling validation errors within the OrangeHRM validation framework, encapsulating validation input and rule details.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new validation exception with input data, the rule that failed validation, and an optional message.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input data associated with the validation error.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data related to the validation error.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves the validation rule associated with the exception.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Assigns a validation rule to the exception.
